capability: Versioned Portfolio State / reconciliation infrastructure audit
reused_certified_infrastructure: R2 fill-level idempotency and projection semantics
r4_hardening_certified: one semantic PortfolioSnapshot validator is shared by persistence and Capital Safety Kernel
aggregate gross/net exposure must exactly match the aggregate position map
strategy gross maps must exactly match strategy position maps
aggregate positions must exactly equal the sum of strategy positions
durable portfolio_state carries an independent SHA-256 commitment over exact persisted snapshot bytes
durable reads validate hash before semantic use and semantically validate even when an attacker recomputes the storage hash
valid legacy portfolio rows are semantically validated before hash backfill; invalid legacy rows fail migration
risk reservation acquisition validates the current portfolio commitment before binding to its version
durable fills verify payload hash and independent identity columns on every read/replay
in-memory snapshots are detached at store boundaries so nested mutable maps cannot change exposure without a version increment
in-memory CAS/initialization/reconciliation writes reject semantically invalid snapshots or non-boolean state flags
in-memory fill batches validate and project fully before publishing any snapshot or fill identity bookkeeping
a late invalid fill or conflicting duplicate inside one batch leaves both exposure and idempotency bookkeeping unchanged
identical no-op reconciliation updates are idempotent and do not create artificial version increments
explicit_non_claims: This audit does not certify correlation-aware portfolio research, allocation robustness, regimes, health/drift or sizing.
In-memory and durable stores share semantic trust invariants but do not claim identical durability mechanisms.
No external PAPER or LIVE order authority is added.
